name: Selfkant (Germany)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red and white in the proportions 2:1:2:1:2, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Selfkant (a rose bush with red roses on white).
history: The banner of the municipality of Selfkant is divided red and white in the ratio 2:1:2:1:2 with the shieldless arms in the white field.

features.role: Selfkant arms — rose bush on white
